name: Diggers
bio: Archetype: DEF Debuff, ATK Debuff, Control. ⌽ Can inflict [Weakness], [Fear] and [Nightmare]; a mix of DMG Reduction and control. ⌽ S2 consistently applies AoE Mental DEF reduction. ⌽ Only gives 15% to a character at a time due to only having -Reality DEF and -Mental DEF ⌽ Ultimate inflicts [Nightmare], extended against debuffed enemies. S1 can apply [Weakness] and S2 [Terror]. ⌽ Insight becomes useless after 3 turns.
